mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PENALTY_NO, PENALTY_TYPE, PENALTY_START_DATE, PENALTY_END_DATE, PENALTY_REASON, PENALTY_STATUS, MEMBER_NO FROM PENALTY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PENALTY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN PENALTY_TYPE = 'PERMANENT' THEN 1 WHEN PENALTY_TYPE = 'SUSPEND' THEN 2 WHEN PENALTY_TYPE = 'WARNING' THEN 3 END, PENALTY_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PENALTY WHERE PENALTY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PENALTY_TYPE != 'WARNING'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PENALTY_NO, PENALTY_TYPE, PENALTY_START_DATE, PENALTY_END_DATE, PENALTY_REASON, PENALTY_STATUS, MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM PENALTY JOIN MEMBER USING (MEMBER_NO) WHERE PENALTY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN PENALTY_TYPE = 'PERMANENT' THEN 1 WHEN PENALTY_TYPE = 'SUSPEND' THEN 2 END, PENALTY_NO DESC )
mapper.update: UPDATE PENALTY SET PENALTY_STATUS = 'EXPIRED', PENALTY_END_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PENALTY_NO = #{penaltyNo}
